body:
Scope: independent M2 milestone review after approved M1, covering the actual scripts/test-build-skills.py correction and the complete bounded audit of its original eight BuildSkillsTests methods plus all ten ModelRecordTests and their parameter/subtest partitions. The second module remains unchanged but is an explicit audit subject. Current approved Test/Workflow and amended Delivery V7 remain the governing basis. M2 assessment does not replace the separate final whole-change checkpoint.

Protection comparison: the removed test_proposal_stage_packages_preserve_canonical_resources called the same main(--output-dir) path and compared complete proposal/proposal-review file dictionaries. The retained complete-mirror test now independently walks both canonical and generated trees and compares relative paths and bytes for all resources, including both proposal skills. Its expected dictionary is not derived from the builder's collect_drift or collection helper. Existing explicit required/forbidden path checks and route/plan content assertions remain. maxDiff=None and relative path/byte dictionary diagnostics retain useful failure localization. The deleted method adds no distinct boundary, condition or diagnostic protection that defeats this consolidation rationale.

TG-03 complete-scope audit assessed: explicit output versus default check retains root-selection/isolation protection; direct malformed validation versus public error reporting retains helper/command differences; stale hashes versus missing resource retains distinct failures and diagnostics. All ModelRecordTests partitions remain: current model acceptance/no activation, directory/example/nesting rejection, flat historical paths, unknown marker/dimension, missing/duplicate/malformed tables and references, non-applicability controls, missing/unsafe/file-and-parent symlink paths, fenced authority, all indented-code variants plus valid three-space control, and public read-only/no-activation behavior. The audit appropriately treats repeated assertion syntax as different from redundant protection. No compatibility, negative-vocabulary, discovery, authority or diagnostic obligation is retired; no uncertain/flaky case is skipped.

TG-04 proof and limits: m2-audit records baseline 8/10 passing classes; strengthened complete-tree comparison passed before the proposal-only case was removed; resulting 7/10 focused classes passed; V7 full post-maintenance modules passed 7 and 87 tests. Isolated fault probe disables collect_drift and introduces missing/changed/extra generated output, with AssertionError for each; I inspected that probe. This demonstrates detection by the retained test. The missing proposal/SKILL.md may be caught by its earlier presence check, so the probe alone is not proof that every corruption reaches the new dictionary assertion. Direct assertion and entrypoint comparison supplies the remaining protection rationale. The initial missing-import-path probe launch is accurately excluded from detection proof; no temporary faults persisted. One explicitly accounted consolidated method explains the discovery-count reduction and all subtest partitions remain.

Checklist results: requirement alignment pass (approved design-derived, diagnostic and safe-maintenance criteria); coverage pass (independent full-tree oracle and complete module proof); edge cases pass (retained missing/stale/extra and all model partitions); error handling pass (no softened required failures); architecture pass (tests change, production and quality/assessment owners unchanged); compatibility pass (historical paths and supported cases retained); security/privacy pass (no new runtime effects or authority); derived currency pass (M1 skills/packages untouched and freshly exercised mirror generation); unrelated scope pass (no helper/fixture/other-class or production edits); evidence adequacy pass (actual current post-change commands plus honest probe limits).

M1 package/runtime evidence remains applicable to unchanged sources, builders, metadata, selection, dependencies and environment; this is unaffected-surface reuse, not a claim that older commands ran on revised tests. Relevant changed tests have fresh post-change proof. No runtime or token improvement claim is inferred from removing one method.

No material finding or required correction emerged. Return this exact milestone judgment to route for M2 disposition. A distinct fresh independent final whole-change review must then assess M1 consumer guidance against M2 maintenance and complete delivered evidence before Verify. No routing, engineering, plan or unrelated assessment was changed by this review.
independence_basis: Separate delegated agent /root/independent_proposal_review authored no tests, helper changes, model or plan content. codex-author performed the audit and engineering correction. This reviewer independently compared the original and retained detection, examined both audit scopes and current evidence, and writes only its assessment. Previous independent upstream/M1 review does not constitute implementation authorship.
